messages:
Samir: Pushed a short proposal for an envelope normalization migration — want feedback before I turn it into a runbook. TL;DR: add envelope_v2, dual-write, backfill via streaming worker, switchreads with feature flag.

Mira: can you paste the DDL and a sketch of the backfill job? interested in how we avoid pg bloat during backfill.

Samir: sure — quick DDL:
```sql
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN envelope_v2 jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_console_events_envelope_v2 ON console_events USING gin (envelope_v2 jsonb_path_ops);
```
Backfill plan: consume compacted event stream (kafka topic events-raw), transform to normalized envelope, write to envelope_v2 in batches with rate limit. Use VACUUM ANALYZE windows and pause if replication lag > 1m.

Hao: two immediate concerns: 1) adding jsonb default can rewrite whole table on older PG — use ADD COLUMN without default then UPDATE in batches. 2) index concurrently is good but monitor locks on heavy write periods.

Samir: good call — I'll change to no-default variant. updated snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN envelope_v2 jsonb;
-- then backfill in app worker with: UPDATE console_events SET envelope_v2 = <normalized> WHERE envelope_v2 IS NULL LIMIT 1000;
```

Ezra: how do we handle reads during rollout? We need stable telemetry: console should keep serving from envelope (v1) until we flip. Suggest dual-read layer: if feature-flag on, prefer envelope_v2, else fall back. Also emit metric event.envelope_v2_read_pct.

Tanya: agree on dual-read. Also recommend we keep a schema_version int in the envelope for future migrations and a small validation job that scans random samples post-backfill (e.g., 10k/day) and reports mismatches.

Samir: adding schema_version is sensible. For validation I'll add a job that compares normalized->reconstructed original and checks essential fields (route_id, tenant_id, ts). Failing rows go to a remediation queue.

Mira: remediation queue should be idempotent and rate-limited. For rows that fail transformation (eg legacy TTL format), we should capture raw payload and create a ticket for app owners, not try to auto-fix.

Hao: ops ask: what's the migration window and worst-case RPO/RTO for console queries while backfill runs? we need to communicate to support.

Samir: estimated full backfill ~48h for prod cluster if we keep it low-priority (1k updates/sec). Worst-case queries unaffected because reads still hit envelope_v1 until feature flag flip; there might be slight IO pressure. I'll draft a support note with recommended read rate caps per region.

Ezra: small nit: use streaming idempotency keys for the backfill worker so retries dont double-update. Put updated_at check in WHERE clause (WHERE envelope_v2 IS NULL AND updated_at < now() + interval '1 hour')? maybe just the NULL check plus idempotent writes.

Samir: will do. Also plan canary: 5% of traffic to envelope_v2 (feature flag targeting), monitor: query error rate, mean latency, and tokenized metrics (console.telemetry.envelope_mismatch_rate). If stable after 24h, ramp 25/50/100.

Tanya: add a health-check dashboard tile showing backfill progress, failed transforms, db bloat estimate, and index build status. Ops needs alerts for index build > 6h or replication lag > 2m.

Samir: noted. I'll add Grafana panels and an alert set.

Mira: one more ask — can we run a dry-run mode where backfill writes to a shadow table first (console_events_shadow) to measure size and transformation correctness without impacting prod main table?

Samir: yes — we can do shadow-run for a week on a sample tenant slice (e.g., tenant_id % 100 in (0..4)). That will give us realistic distribution and cost estimate.

Hao: +1. please include rollback steps in the runbook: 1) pause backfill workers, 2) revert feature flag to v1, 3) drop envelope_v2 writes from app, 4) if index created, drop idx concurrently.

Samir: will assemble full runbook with commands, PromQL alerts, and a step-by-step checklist. Targeting to post the runbook and open a cutover PR by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: backfill-worker-v0.1 -> staging at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z.

Ezra: thanks — if you want I can help with the dashboard queries and alert thresholds.

Samir: appreciate it, tagging you for dashboard review. I'll update the draft and ping infra for a low-priority pg maintenance window.

Mira: sprintly FYI: add this migration to the eng-platform migration board so SRE can allocate runbook on-call.

Samir: done — created ticket EP-8421 and linked runbook draft. Will share link here when ready. :thumbsup:
